title: Victoria Launches Child Safety Training for Early Childhood Educators
body: The Victorian Government has launched new child safety and protection training specifically designed for early childhood educators. While this training is aimed at childcare and kindergarten settings, sporting clubs working with young children may find the resources helpful for their own safeguarding programs. The training is now available through the Victorian Government's professional development platform.

title: Frankston Basketball Updates Child Safety Requirements for Members
body: Frankston and District Basketball Association has issued updated child safety requirements for all members, volunteers and staff. The update appears to align with Victoria's Child Safe Standards and includes reminders about Working With Children Check requirements. Victorian sporting clubs should review their own compliance processes against current state requirements.

title: eSafety Commissioner Marks National Child Protection Week 2026
body: The eSafety Commissioner has released resources and guidance for National Child Protection Week 2026, focusing on online safety for children and young people. Sporting clubs can access toolkits, safety guides and educational resources to help protect young participants from online risks including cyberbullying, inappropriate content and abuse. The resources are available on the eSafety Commissioner website.
